narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly alike. At the first appraisal in month {fork_month}, you took {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months after that. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, at the bottom of the fall, and the ghost walked into it holding {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its days felt almost no different from yours, with Life {life_gap}.
